newsitem.title: USA: Phillips to restore Texas cracker late Thurs.
newsitem.headline: Phillips to restore Texas cracker late Thurs.

text.p: Phillips Petroleum Co said it hoped by Thursday evening to return a 64,000 barrel per day (bpd) catalytic cracker to service from planned maintenance following an unexpected delay in restoring the unit at its 185,000 bpd refinery in Sweeny, Texas.
"We anticipate it will be back up in a matter of hours; they're introducing the cat feed now," a Phillips spokesman said at 1555 EDT (2055 GMT).
The spokesman said the company was unable for proprietary reasons to disclose other details, but traders said the cracker had been taken out of service for over a month for scheduled maintenance.
Phillips acknowledged there was a delay in restarting the unit, but gave no details on the extent and cause of the delay.

On a day otherwise short on news, reports about the delay helped differentials widen about 0.40 cent a gallon on Gulf Coast "M1" grade conventional unleaded gasoline -- to 2.80 cents below May futures for prompt front 11th-cycle material.
((- Ransdell Pierson, New York Energy Desk, 212 859-1632))
